definition: covered in red, like from a wound
description: In a restaurant kitchen, a blender full of red tomato sauce bursts and sprays a young man in a white vest and a cream apron. He throws up his hands in shock, wipes his face and then stands still at the counter, his face, shoulder and arm dripping with bright red sauce, looking fed up. Red splashes cover the white tiles and the steel counter. A young woman in a black top and apron stands behind him, smiling and holding the blender's clear lid. Jars of spices sit on a shelf above.

taps.phrase: to wipe sauce off his face
